text: When you find a good doctor, you have to share! I'm an amateur golfer who has suffered from chronic injuries from the sport for over two years. My right back is hunched, I have chronic pain in my right shoulder blade, shoulder, and neck, stiffness in my right hip and lower back, and severe pain in my knee and ankle – basically, the entire right side is problematic. In the past, I've received recommendations from well-wishers to seek treatment, including injections, massage therapy, and chiropractic adjustments at various places, both in Bangkok and at well-known clinics throughout Chiang Mai. In fact, I was listed as a patient at all those famous places. But two days ago, these symptoms returned. This time, I decided to consult Google, read reviews, and called to inquire about the cost. I found out that a course of treatment (approximately 1 to 1 hour 40 minutes, depending on the severity) was less than 1000 baht, which I found acceptable. So I went there. I found a small clinic in San Na Meng Subdistrict, San Sai District, located almost at the end of a right-hand side street. There was a small parking area. The team consisted of three people: a tall, well-built male doctor named Dr. Ko, a female doctor, and a nurse assistant. They took my medical history... They checked my blood pressure and inquired about my symptoms, following the standards of a good clinic. They then described the treatment methods they thought were suitable for my condition. Since my symptoms were numerous, I opted for two courses. It started with a muscle relaxation massage, followed by cupping therapy (I'm allergic to cupping), and other miscellaneous treatments. The female doctor had very strong fingers; it wasn't painful because she pressed on the right pressure points, but with great power. Meanwhile, the other doctor, a man in his 40s, engaged in pleasant conversation and exchanged insightful ideas. Then came the chiropractic course, which I must admit was unlike anything I'd ever experienced before. Both doctors worked together, meticulously manipulating, pressing, and adjusting the bones. I was particularly impressed by their use of a cloth to manipulate my neck (a technique only some well-known clinics offer). The most impressive technique was their ankle-locking method to apply force to my hip bones (which I've had chronic pain in), a technique they waited until the end after everything else had relaxed. I'd never seen this method anywhere else. After the treatment, I felt incredibly relieved, more so than ever before. The treatment took about 3 hours, included a large packet of herbal medicine, and cost a total of 1905 baht, which was still cheaper than many well-known clinics I've been to. After returning home... In the evening, there was some soreness (as Dr. Ko had predicted in advance), but I slept longer at night, only waking up to go to the bathroom once (compared to the usual 2-3 times a night). In the morning, I felt relieved, my head felt better, and my body felt more relaxed. I need to go to the hot springs and cold springs and choose to eat only one type of fruit all day for one day to detox my intestines before returning for further treatment here. I have found hope, a feeling that my chronic condition can be completely cured here.
